'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Sean Ryan DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Sean Ryan]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
